app.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
app.privacy.s1.title: 1. Data Controller
app.privacy.s1.body: The data controller is Javier Garcia Mateos (tax ID 07991565P), Avenida de los Tulipanes 30, 46185 La Pobla de Vallbona (Valencia), Spain, owner of Money Manager (winjgm.com). Contact: moneymanager@outlook.es. The server is hosted by Hetzner Online GmbH (Helsinki, Finland), within the European Union, so processing is governed by the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
app.privacy.s2.title: 2. Data We Collect
app.privacy.s2.intro: To provide the service we collect only the strictly necessary data:
app.privacy.s2.item1: Name and email address (registration and authentication).
app.privacy.s2.item2: Password (stored encrypted with bcrypt; never in plain text).
app.privacy.s2.item3: Optional profile picture (an image you upload yourself).
app.privacy.s2.item4: Personal financial data: transactions (amount, description, category, date), categories, budgets and automation rules you enter.
app.privacy.s2.item5: JWT session tokens, stored on your device (localStorage).
app.privacy.s3.title: 3. Purpose and Legal Basis
app.privacy.s3.intro: We use your data exclusively to:
app.privacy.s3.item1: Provide the personal finance management service (legal basis: contract performance, Art. 6.1.b GDPR).
app.privacy.s3.item2: Send transactional emails: account verification and password reset (legal basis: contract performance).
app.privacy.s3.item3: Generate AI financial analysis at your explicit request (legal basis: explicit consent, Art. 6.1.a GDPR).
app.privacy.s3.noMarketing: We do not carry out marketing, profiling or behavioural analysis.
app.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third Parties and International Transfers
app.privacy.s4.p1: We do not share your data with third parties for commercial purposes. The only providers involved are:
app.privacy.s4.item1: Hetzner Online GmbH (server hosting, EU — no transfer outside the EEA).
app.privacy.s4.item2: Cloudflare Workers AI (AI analyses, Premium only): the aggregated figures of the month are sent when you ask for an analysis and, when you import a statement, the movement descriptions without long numbers (IBANs, cards). Cloudflare does not use this data to train models.
app.privacy.s4.item3: Cloudflare (CDN and DNS): handles network traffic. See their policy at cloudflare.com/privacypolicy.
app.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Retention
app.privacy.s5.p1: Your data is retained while you maintain an active account. If you delete your account, all your data is permanently erased within a maximum of 30 days.
app.privacy.s5.p2: Stripe keeps payments and invoices for as long as tax law requires, even if you delete your account.
app.privacy.s6.title: 6. Security
app.privacy.s6.p1: We apply the following technical measures:
app.privacy.s6.item2: Passwords hashed with bcrypt (high cost factor).
app.privacy.s6.item3: Authentication via short-lived JWT tokens with refresh token.
app.privacy.s6.item4: The server does not log personal data in access logs.
app.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Rights (GDPR)
app.privacy.s7.intro: As a user you have the right to:
app.privacy.s7.item1: Access: request a copy of your data.
app.privacy.s7.item2: Rectification: correct inaccurate data from your profile.
app.privacy.s7.item3: Erasure ('right to be forgotten'): delete your account and all associated data.
app.privacy.s7.item4: Portability: export all your data as JSON, or your movements as CSV, from "Settings → Your data".
app.privacy.s7.item5: Objection and restriction of processing: contact us at any time.
app.privacy.s7.item6: Complaint: if you believe we have violated your rights you may lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (aepd.es) or your local supervisory authority.
app.privacy.s8.title: 8. Cookies and Local Storage
app.privacy.s8.p1: This application does not use tracking or analytics cookies. It only uses the browser's localStorage to maintain your session (JWT token) and your language preference. This data is not shared with third parties.
app.privacy.s9.title: 9. Minors
app.privacy.s9.p1: The service is not directed at persons under 16 years of age. If you are under 16, you must not create an account or provide us with personal data.
app.privacy.s10.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
app.privacy.s10.p1: We may update this policy occasionally. We will notify you via an in-app notice. The last updated date will always be visible at the top of this page.
app.privacy.s11.title: 11. Account Deletion
app.privacy.s11.p1: You can permanently delete your account and all associated data directly from within the app at any time. No email or external form is required.
app.privacy.s11.step1: Open the app and log in.
app.privacy.s11.step2: Tap the profile icon (top right) to open your profile.
app.privacy.s11.step3: Scroll down and open the "Settings" section.
app.privacy.s11.step4: Tap "Delete account" and confirm in the dialog.
app.privacy.s11.p2: Upon confirmation, your account and all data (transactions, categories, budgets, recurring rules and profile picture) are permanently and irreversibly deleted from our servers.

terms.title: Terms of sale
terms.s1.title: 1. Service provider
terms.s1.body: Money Manager is provided by Javier Garcia Mateos, tax ID (NIF) 07991565P, address Avenida de los Tulipanes 30, 46185 La Pobla de Vallbona (Valencia), Spain. Contact: moneymanager@outlook.es.
terms.s2.title: 2. Plans
terms.s2.body: The Free plan costs nothing and has usage limits (accounts, budgets, goals, automations and alerts). Premium removes those limits and adds bank statement import, trends and net worth analysis and the AI advisor (with a monthly maximum of analyses). Prices are shown in euros, VAT included.
terms.s3.title: 3. Free trial
terms.s3.body: New accounts get 14 days of Premium at no cost and without a card. Afterwards the account moves to the Free plan and keeps all its data.
terms.s4.title: 4. Payment, renewal and cancellation
terms.s4.body: Payments are processed by Stripe; we never receive your card details. Before paying you must accept these terms; we keep the date and the version you accepted. Monthly and yearly subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each period until you cancel them in "Your plan → Manage subscription". After cancelling you are not charged again and you keep Premium until the end of the period already paid; the unused part of the period is not refunded. The Founder plan is a one-time payment that grants Premium for as long as the service is available.
terms.s5.title: 5. Right of withdrawal
terms.s5.body: Premium starts as soon as you pay. That is why, when you buy, we ask you to expressly request that immediate start and to acknowledge that you therefore lose the 14-day right of withdrawal; we confirm it by e-mail together with the purchase. Before paying you get a 14-day free Premium trial to decide. All of this without prejudice to the rights the law grants you as a consumer.
terms.s6.title: 6. AI and partner offers
terms.s6.body: AI-generated analyses are for guidance only and are not financial advice. The "Offers" section contains sponsored links labelled as such, which you can hide in Settings.
terms.s7.title: 7. Governing law
terms.s7.body: These terms are governed by Spanish law. Consumers may go to the courts of their place of residence.

app.tour.welcome.title: 👋 Welcome to Money Manager!
app.tour.welcome.body: Let me show you how everything works in a couple of minutes. Move on with "Next" (or the arrow keys) and leave whenever you want with "Skip the tour" or Esc.
app.tour.monthNav.title: 📅 Pick the month
app.tour.monthNav.body: "‹ Previous" and "Next ›" move between months, and "Go to current month" brings you back to today. Everything below belongs to that month. If your month starts on another day (for example, payday), change it in Settings.
app.tour.options.title: ⋯ Month options
app.tour.options.body: Export the month's movements to CSV (for Excel) and import your bank statement as CSV or Norma 43: the app detects the columns, skips duplicates and suggests categories. Importing is a Premium feature.
app.tour.summary.title: 📊 Month summary
app.tour.summary.body: Income, expenses and savings of the month, the balance, your savings rate and the available balance, which adds what is left from previous months. If a budget or an alert goes off, the warning shows up right above.
app.tour.newTransaction.title: ➕ Add a movement
app.tour.newTransaction.body: Choose the type (expense, income or saving), the amount, the description, the category, the account and the date. In the category list, "Manage categories" lets you create, rename or delete your own, with their emoji and colour.
app.tour.movements.title: 📋 Your movements
app.tour.movements.body: See them by day, by week or on a calendar with the tabs above. Edit or delete any movement and add notes right from the list. Further down there is the expenses-by-category chart.
app.tour.aiAdvisor.title: 🤖 AI financial advisor
app.tour.aiAdvisor.body: It analyses your month and gives you a summary, what you are doing well, warnings and saving tips. It is Premium (30 analyses a month) and only uses the month's aggregated figures. It is guidance, not financial advice.
app.tour.menu.title: ☰ The menu
app.tour.menu.body: This button takes you to every section. Let's go through them one by one.
app.tour.annual.title: 📊 Yearly balance
app.tour.annual.body: Income, expenses and savings of every month of the year in a chart and a table, with the totals. Change the year with the arrows and press a month to open it.
app.tour.analysis.title: 📈 Analysis
app.tour.analysis.body: Compares each category's spending with the previous month and the average of the three months before, and follows your net worth (available + saved). It is a Premium feature.
app.tour.search.title: 🔎 Search
app.tour.search.body: Find any movement by its description or notes and filter by type, category, account, dates and amount. You can edit them from the results too.
app.tour.accounts.title: 🏦 Accounts
app.tour.accounts.body: Split your money into accounts (current, savings, cash, card, investment…) with their opening balance, choose the default one and record transfers between them: moving money counts neither as an expense nor as income.
app.tour.budgets.title: 🎯 Budgets
app.tour.budgets.body: Set a monthly limit for each category. The month summary shows a progress bar per category, and we warn you at 80 % and when you go over.
app.tour.goals.title: 🏁 Savings goals
app.tour.goals.body: Create a goal (a trip, a car…) with its target and, if you like, a date. Each goal uses a category: Saving movements in that category fill it up, and we tell you how much to save each month to make it on time.
app.tour.automations.title: ⚙️ Automatic movements
app.tour.automations.body: For what repeats (salary, rent, subscriptions): set the amount, category and frequency (monthly, every 2 months, quarterly or yearly) and the movement is created by itself in each period, from the start month to the end month.
app.tour.alerts.title: 🔔 Alerts
app.tour.alerts.body: Create your own warnings: for example, when your expenses go over 80 % of what is available, when you save less than 10 % of your income or when a category goes over an amount. They show up in the month summary.
app.tour.plan.title: ⭐ Your plan
app.tour.plan.body: Here you see your plan, the trial days you have left and how much of each Free plan limit you use.
app.tour.offers.title: 🎁 Offers
app.tour.offers.body: Financial products from our partners (savings accounts, brokers, insurance…), labelled as sponsored: if you sign up for one, we may earn a commission. If they don't interest you, hide them in Settings.
app.tour.settings.title: 🛠️ Settings
app.tour.settings.body: Currency, language, the day your month starts, the default account, reminders and whether you want this tour when you sign in. You can also export all your data (JSON or CSV) and sign out on every device.
app.tour.profile.title: 👤 Your profile
app.tour.profile.body: Change your name, photo and password, or delete the account with all its data.
app.tour.language.title: 🌐 Language
app.tour.language.body: Switch between Spanish and English whenever you want.
app.tour.done.title: 🎉 All set!
app.tour.done.body: Now you know the whole app. You can replay this tour any time from Settings → App tour. Tick "Don't show again" if you don't want to see it every time you sign in.
app.settings.tourHint: A guided, step-by-step walk through every section.
